narrative:
FY2027 operating expenses are planned at GBP 302M (7.9% of revenue) alongside a GBP 245M capital programme: GBP 60M for care-home refurbishment, GBP 83M for clinics and Cromwell, GBP 47M for dental equipment and GBP 55M for digital and AI.

The finance stack itself is a saving. Decommissioning Oracle EPM and Business Objects once planning and reporting run on Snowflake and Sigma avoids about GBP 4.2M a year, and Cortex AI is already security-approved to automate claims correspondence in Bupa Global.

The agent proposes two reductions and one deliberate increase: pre-opening opex for two new London clinics, justified by the revenue ramp locked in Step 1.

signals.title: Oracle EPM BU Planning Paused
signals.excerpt: Business-unit planning on Oracle EPM has been paused. Group planning already runs on Snowflake after the TM1 to Anaplan to Snowflake migration delivered with EY.

signals.title: Reporting Migration to Snowflake + Sigma
signals.excerpt: Business Objects reporting is moving to Snowflake with Sigma, giving finance input grids, workflow and write-back on governed data.

signals.title: Cortex AI Security Approval
signals.excerpt: Snowflake Cortex AI functions are approved for finance and claims data inside the Bupa Snowflake account. No data leaves the governance boundary.
